about: The checker's offline copy of Sepolia's format 2 listings (box-spec-v2-draft.md § 4). The source is the indexer (M1-52), which reads every listing from the listing registry's events; the platform's Safe adds listings at any time and each counts at once (F90 R16A), so a newer listing than this copy is still offered when the indexer answers (`--listings`, `--indexer`).

Not deployed yet: core v2 M1 reaches Sepolia in M1-64 (rehearsal build, F78). Until then only listing 0 exists by construction (native ETH, ReleaseConstantsV2.NATIVE_LISTING_ID), at the rehearsal raise. M1-64 lists the test tokens (tickets § 5), then this copy is written again from the indexer.

Fields per listing: the registry's ListingRecord (IListingRegistry.sol) that validate() and the page need (id, address: its `token`, decimals, class, kind, burnable, used, pools, earlierListing, listedAt, raise, converter), plus what the indexer adds from the token and the listing review (symbol, label, powers); a box token adds its box and the raise band of its lowest reading (raiseBand: min and max in its units, F95 R19H), which the factory reads again at creation. `byRule`: graduated boxes whose token anyone may list by rule (addBoxToken) before a box is priced in it.
